title: World Labs Marble: Generative 3D World Models
summary: A spatial intelligence platform that generates persistent and navigable 3D environments from text, images, or video using Gaussian Splatting. It provides high-fidelity world generation for creators, developers, and robotics training.
research_notes: Founded by Dr. Fei-Fei Li; employs 3D Gaussian Splatting to ensure geometric stability and photorealism across generated worlds.

evolution.summary: The platform evolved from a research preview to a commercial ecosystem with the release of version 1.1 and 1.1 Plus, featuring Dynamic Cubes for massive landscapes and the Chisel editor for manual layout control.
